property_snapshot.Name: Dodecahedron of Devouring Whispers
property_snapshot.Notes: Soul manipulation, identity anchor, cosmic power
property_snapshot.Origin: Dodecahedron of Devouring Whispers — Arik's primary soul-working tool

property_snapshot.Name: Ward of Dimensional Stability
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Elegant brooch of interwoven silver and obsidian, shaped like closed eye surrounded by geometric patterns that hurt to follow. Microscopic Futhark runes in silver. Obsidian absorbs light suggesting extra-dimensional depth. Subtle metaphysical 'weight' when worn. Back inscribed in thieves' cant: 'What cannot be moved cannot be stolen.'

PROPERTIES:
• Dimensional Anchoring: Cannot be moved to another plane against will
• Anti-Teleportation: Cannot be teleported against will
• Death Magic Protection: Resistance to necrotic damage, advantage on saves vs death effects

HISTORY: Originally commissioned by 'Paranoid Pellax,' wizard with twelve escape plans for his bedroom. Ironically killed by simple knife in alley. Acquired by Baldur's Gate Guild, modified by Guild mages to Shi'van's specifications adding death magic protection.

TACTICAL VALUE: Perfect for operative who needs to stay put when enemies try to remove her. Counters standard assassination-by-banishment tactics.

property_snapshot.Name: Pale Death Armor
property_snapshot.Notes: Power armor crafted by Korgan, caused Guardian's Gate transformation

property_snapshot.Name: Yggdrasil Seed Orb
property_snapshot.Notes: Collaborative creation, drow/Norse magical fusion, portable fortress

property_snapshot.Name: Codex of Tactical Supremacy
property_snapshot.Notes: Provenance CORRECTED (this batch): Malachar the Ironruin's spoil from the Screaming Chasm engagement, given to Captain Zareth Flameborn (devil ally, CR 9) — NOT the Dis Gambit treasure division. Tome of 247 documented demon weaknesses (Malachar's centuries of compiled Blood War analysis). Name-collision flag: Captain Zareth Flameborn is a different being from Marshal Zar'geth, the Dis Gambit pit fiend Arik killed.

property_snapshot.Name: Soul-Enhanced Boots
property_snapshot.Notes:
CREATED: Session 3

SOUL SOURCE: Cave bat + subterranean lizard qualities

PROPERTIES:
• Enhanced vertical traction (climb any surface)
• Temperature sensitivity
• Echo-location capabilities
• Sound dampening

DESIGN: Soles grip any surface with unusual tenacity. Demonstrates soul infusion versatility beyond weapons.

STATUS: VAULTED for heir - superseded by current gear.

property_snapshot.Name: Scrolls of Planar Binding (3)
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Three ancient parchments inscribed with spells for summoning and binding extraplanar entities.

PROPERTIES:
• Summon extraplanar entities
• Bind entities using soul energy as primary component
• Compatible with existing soul manipulation techniques

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's treasure hoard.

STATUS: Reserved for future planar operations. Formulae use soul energy, compatible with Dodecahedron.

property_snapshot.Name: Soul-Enhanced Throwing Daggers
property_snapshot.Notes:
CREATED: Session 2

SOUL SOURCE: Combined warrior soul qualities

PROPERTIES:
• Return to wielder after thrown
• Psychic connection (sense location always)
• Silent flight
• Trajectory adjustment mid-flight
• Move in perfect synchronization when thrown together

QUANTITY: Set of 6

DESIGN: Infinitely reusable without recovery time.

STATUS: VAULTED for heir.

property_snapshot.Name: Bracers of Demon's Grip
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Demonic gladiator gear

PHYSICAL: Heavy bracers of blackite metal with infernal script. Sized for combat, not ceremony.

PROPERTIES:
• +2 AC
• Grapple attacks against fiends have advantage
• Resistance to being grappled by fiends
• Unarmed strikes count as magical vs fiends

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard. Originally arena equipment for demon gladiators.

STATUS: Stored in vault. Available for assignment to lieutenant or ally who needs defensive boost, particularly for Hell operations.

POTENTIAL RECIPIENTS: Bloodaxe Legion officer, Veil operative, or vaulted for heir.

property_snapshot.Name: Bowstring of the Wonderbringer
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Divine engineering component (Gond)

PHYSICAL: Bowstring that emits faint sparks of divine energy. Craftsmanship beyond mortal capability - each fiber perfectly aligned, tension self-adjusting.

PROPERTIES (when installed on any bow):
• +1 to attack rolls
• Auto-loading: no action required to nock arrows
• 1/day Splitting Shot: next arrow fired splits into 3 arrows targeting up to 3 creatures within 30ft of each other (separate attack rolls, full damage each)

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard. Divine craftsmanship suggests Gond clergy creation - how demon lord acquired it unknown (likely killed the archer who used it).

STATUS: Stored in vault.

POTENTIAL USES:
• Give to archer ally
• Sell to Gond temple (significant religious value)
• Trade to craftsman for favors
• Equip scout/ranger commander

property_snapshot.Name: Deceiver's Mirror
property_snapshot.Notes:
DISTRIBUTED: Given to infiltrator devil during Dis Gambit treasure division.

FUNCTION: Psychological warfare enhancement. Synergizes with intelligent approach to infiltration.

STATUS: In allied hands. Full stats TBD if devil returns with item.

property_snapshot.Name: Xorlarrin Dimensional Countermeasures
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Captured enemy technology collection

COMPONENTS:
• Crystalline focus devices (anti-phase)
• Specialized detection goggles (phase-sight)
• Dimensional disruption nets

CAPABILITIES:
• Countermeasures against dimensional phasing
• Detection of phase-shifted entities
• Dimensional disruption

ORIGIN: Captured following House Xorlarrin ambush targeting Arik and assets.

INTELLIGENCE VALUE: Demonstrates Xorlarrin's advanced dimensional research and active opposition. May be reverse-engineered for defensive purposes.

property_snapshot.Name: Pharizia Hunzrin's Pendant
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Emergency failsafe / soul anchor

PHYSICAL: Elegant pendant with unusual dimensional resonance detectable by Dodecahedron.

FUNCTION: Hunzrin insurance policy. If Pharizia dies or is captured, pendant returns her body/soul to predetermined secure location (likely Hunzrin vault or allied temple).

PROPERTIES:
• Death-triggered teleport (body + soul)
• Capture-triggered beacon (alerts Hunzrin security)
• Dimensional anchor preventing unwanted planar travel
• Possibly stores backup of recent memories

TACTICAL IMPLICATIONS: To permanently remove Pharizia, must deal with pendant first. Options: remove before killing, destroy pendant, block teleport destination, or ensure death is so complete soul cannot be recovered.

INTELLIGENCE VALUE: Arik's awareness of this failsafe is strategic advantage. Hunzrin doesn't know he knows.
property_snapshot.Origin: Death-triggered soul teleport failsafe — threat intel

property_snapshot.Name: Medallion from Between Planes
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Ancient medallion of unknown metal, acquired through Bregan D'aerthe. Surface displays impossible geometries that shift when not directly observed.

CONNECTION: Linked to twelve-fingered entities - the beings from 'between planes' connected to Dodecahedron's origin.

FUNCTION: Two-way observation device. The entities watch their investment (Arik/Dodecahedron). Arik occasionally perceives glimpses of their realm.

PROPERTIES:
• Passive awareness of Convergence proximity
• Occasional cryptic visions from entity realm
• Advantage on saves vs planar displacement
• Grows warm when Convergence events approach
• May allow limited communication at critical moments

ORIGIN: Session 4 acquisition through Bregan D'aerthe contacts. Connected to ancient texts about Dodecahedron's significance.

WARNING: Not a tool - a window. The entities are watching.
property_snapshot.Origin: Twelve-fingered entities — two-way window, Convergence warning
